paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.69% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.67%) and FTSE 100 weakest (-2.36%). Brent crude changed -5.45% to 100.79. Gold changed -2.33% to 4,198.0. Bitcoin changed -0.25% to 84,191.5469. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.241%, a relative move of +1.53%. Among the firms tracked, TotalEnergies (-7.64%) and Santander (-7.46%) moved the most.
